email_body:
Dear Meenal,

I am writing on behalf of the deal team for Project Rioja (Semiconductors & High-Tech, day-1 readiness). We are exploring a term loan of about USD 174K to fund one-time IT separation cost.

Aggregated need (no client-identifying detail):
• One-time separation cost: USD 4.1M
• Already secured: USD 2.36M (58%)
• Still without a source after options already in discussion: USD 174K
• Purpose: Engineering tool licences and test equipment for Day-1
• Indicative tenor: 3-5 years

Could you share indicative terms (pricing, tenor, fees and conditions) and the information you would need for a first credit view? Happy to set up a short call.

Detailed data would only be shared under an NDA and through the clean team, once the client has agreed.

Kind regards,
Daniel Brooks
Engagement Manager, Deals
notes: Waiting for the independence check before the Partner sends it.
